ns2:section.sectionText: This course introduces students to the foundations of entrepreneurship and evolving business models for media. The course will be divided into three sections. In the first section, students are introduced to the foundation and context of entrepreneurship. The second section will cover the skills and practices necessary for new entrepreneurial ventures, as well as the processes of evaluating an idea, assessing the market, and implementing a new venture. In the third section, students will examine business case studies for both successful and unsuccessful media start-ups. Meets with ADV 490-M (CRN 61096)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
